papers.key_result: SportQA: 70,000+ MCQs across three difficulty levels (facts, rules/tactics, scenario-based multi-hop). GPT-4 best on L3 hard multi-hop ~23-29% vs ~92% human; chain-of-thought prompting helps multi-step sports reasoning; error taxonomy (conceptual, known-info misuse, fact recall). Transfer: CoT standard for GSE's LLM content pipeline + decision-weighted benchmark scoring.
papers.title: SportQA: A Benchmark for Sports Understanding in Large Language Models

papers.key_result: Kelly criterion derived via projective symmetries; fractional-Kelly rationale and the 'no-go' warning for large bankrolls where stakes move the line. One projective-geometry figure page did not text-extract; all equations and prose read. Transfer: fractional-Kelly sizing for GSE bankroll management with market-impact guardrail.
papers.title: Kelly Criterion revisited: optimal bets

papers.key_result: Inductive Conformal Martingale ensemble with novel CAUTIOUS betting functions + interpolated-histogram / nearest-neighbor density estimators for concept drift; ensemble size study on 4 benchmark datasets beats prior methodology and matches/exceeds 3 SOTA drift detectors. Transfer: market-relative nonconformity ICM for detecting GSE edge-regime decay.
papers.title: ICM Ensemble with Novel Betting Functions for Concept Drift

papers.key_result: Two-stage game: symmetric BNE of contestant subgame fully characterized (equilibrium invariant to participant-count knowledge); winner-takes-all remains dominant for effort objectives, simple contests optimal for participation objectives; tractable designer equilibrium under common threshold. Full appendix proofs read (Lemma 1-5, Theorems 1-5). Transfer: DFS prize-structure design guidance.
papers.title: Optimal Prize Design in Parallel Rank-order Contests

papers.key_result: Forecast combination framework for hierarchical/grouped time-series reconciliation: maximal candidate-forecast construction from aggregation constraints; MSE-optimal combination weights exactly recover MinT; separability across bottom-level series (Bates-Granger per series); penalized Joint/Separate estimation with egalitarian penalties. Entire 28-page Electronic Companion read (proofs, grouped/unbalanced structures, LCC interpretation, unconstrained reformulation, rolling-origin experiments). Transfer: MinT reconciliation for GSE's multi-level projections.
papers.title: A Forecast Combination Framework for Hierarchical and Grouped Time Series Reconciliation

papers.key_result: Prospective cohort, 1670 Danish schoolchildren over 5.5 years; uncoupled 5-week ACWR via GAMM best: injury risk ~3% for ACWR 0.8-1.5, min 1.5% at ACWR=0, max 6% at ACWR=5. REJECT: pediatric pain-activity data with no path to NFL value; replaced by 1510.
papers.title: Injury risk increases minimally over a large range of changes in activity level in children

papers.key_result: Human-AI selective-prediction experiment: revealing deferral status WITHOUT the AI's uncertain prediction significantly boosts composite human-AI accuracy (avoiding anchoring); showing the uncertain prediction drags reviewers below chance where both are weak (errors covary, agreement 44.9% on model-wrong cases). Transfer: DO-style messaging (status only, no engine lean) for GSE's human review of abstained matchups + deferral-budget abstention policy.
papers.title: Role of Human-AI Interaction in Selective Prediction

papers.key_result: 3D Earth-Specific Transformer, 256M params on 43 years ERA5 at 0.25 deg; first AI model to beat SOTA NWP (IFS) on all variables/leads; hierarchical temporal aggregation cuts cumulative error (7x 24h chaining vs 28x 6h); RQE tail metric shows extremes underestimated. Transfer: multi-lead-time greedy projection chaining for GSE; RQE audit of game-time weather inputs (wind) for totals models.
papers.title: Pangu-Weather: A 3D High-Resolution Model for Fast and Accurate Global Weather Forecast

papers.key_result: Time-varying BT via kernel smoothing of pairwise comparisons; Ford (1957) condition adapted to smoothed data (Condition 4.1, strong connectivity) for existence/uniqueness; oracle bounds via Simons-Yao in model-agnostic setting; LOOCV bandwidth tuner; NFL 2011-2015 application matches 6-10 of ELO top-10 per season. Entire Appendix 9 read (all theorem proofs, LOOCV section, supplementary experiments with h*=0.03). Transfer: minimalist time-varying rating benchmark + LOOCV bandwidth discipline + Condition-4.1 existence guardrail.
papers.title: Nonparametric Estimation in the Dynamic Bradley-Terry Model

papers.key_result: Upset-frequency model across five major leagues: standings variance (sigma) linked to underdog win probability q via fixed-upset-probability model; NFL most competitive (q~0.36); competitiveness rising over time. Transfer: single-number parity metric for moneyline calibration + cheap mid-season parity nowcast from standings.
papers.title: What is the most competitive sport?

papers.key_result: Pure theory: program markets and verification-falsification games for betting on FOL claims without fixed resolution criteria; no sports data, no empirical mechanism, no defensible GSE transfer. REJECT: fails the active-and-valuable standard; replaced by 1511.
papers.title: Betting on what is neither verifiable nor falsifiable

papers.key_result: Sports Intelligence QA benchmark (text + video): best hard multi-hop LLM ~29% vs ~92% human; specialized AFT video baseline ~59% vs general VLMs 19-32%; four-class text error taxonomy. Transfer: CoT prompting standard for sports reasoning, error taxonomy for GSE content-pipeline regression testing, human-review requirement for multi-hop scenario analysis.
papers.title: Sports Intelligence: Assessing the Sports Understanding Capabilities of Language Models through Question Answering from Text to Video

replacements.key_result: Denominator gradient gamma: log recorded minutes regressed on the workload under study; gamma>0.05 in all 15 football leagues means per-minute injury rates divide away up to 14% of the rate ratio; calibration sweep maps gamma to attenuation share; decision rule (restrict to starters or report per-appearance). Appendix A (Table 3, all 5 figure panels + full captions) fully read. Replaces REJECT 1491; fills causal_injury lane with workload-injury measurement rigor that transfers to NFL snap data.
replacements.title: Playing time tracks recent exposure in fifteen men's and women's football leagues: the denominator gradient and what it does to per-minute injury rates

replacements.key_result: ADF/KPSS stationarity tests, return distributions (kurtosis~1.1), Hill tail index, autocorrelation decay (no memory beyond lag 1-2), volatility clustering on one month of Betfair horse-racing prices; markets efficient at beta~1.19 but with heavy tails. Qualification: one-month sample, no code/data, padded references. Replaces REJECT 1496; adapt the five-test efficiency battery to NFL line movement.
replacements.title: Efficient Market Dynamics: Unraveling Informational Efficiency in UK Horse Racing Betting Markets Through Betfair's Time Series Analysis
